== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Gold]] [[dragons]] are a lineage of [[sacred beasts]] characterized by their natural affinity for [[water]] and [[fire aura]]. Historically, they served as a subordinate family to the [[Black dragons|black dragons]], who once ruled the continent with superior power. While they possess a powerful draconic form, many gold [[dragons]] prefer to maintain human appearances due to an advanced aesthetic sense and the efficiency of moving [[madra]] through a human body. This preference for transformation is shared by influential figures like the [[Dragon Monarch]], [[Seshethkunaaz]]. In terms of progression, gold [[dragons]] are categorized by levels such as [[Lowgold]], [[Highgold]], and [[Truegold]], which indicate the density of their [[madra]]. While lower-level [[dragons]] may appear as large lizards or serpents, they are highly intelligent and capable of speech. As they advance, their physical forms change significantly. [[Truegold]] [[dragons]] often appear as humanoids with draconic features like [[scales]], tails, and claws. They are known for using specialized abilities such as [[black dragon's breath|dragon's breath]]—a stream of liquid flame—and can utilize various [[constructs]] like [[Thousand-Mile Cloud|Thousand-Mile Clouds]] for movement. [[Gold]] [[dragons]] are often perceived as arrogant or tyrannical, a reputation stemming from their long period of unopposed rule. They are capable of forming teams and acting as representatives for various clans or sages. Some individuals within the lineage, such as [[Sopharanatoth]], lead specialized groups of [[dragons]]. While they are formidable combatants, they can also be susceptible to [[madra]] corruption.}}

== Uncrowned ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|The gold [[dragons]] are a notoriously cruel and vicious royal family of [[dragons]], including the lineage to which [[Sopharanatoth]] belongs. While they possess a serpentine body with four clawed limbs, gleaming fangs, and shining eyes, they also appear more human than other [[dragons]] due to [[scales]] that imitate hair. These creatures are capable of spewing bright orange liquid flame and previously damaged a [[cloudship]] to weaken the [[Akura clan]] during the [[tournament]]. Despite their involvement in such tactics, they have not claimed responsibility for the delay experienced by the [[Blackflame team]].}}
